texts.name: The Antler Glades
texts.blurb: Glades where the stags wear crowns.

raw.name: The wood walks
raw.blurb: Every 112 seconds roots close 3 ways and open 3 others. A green glow marks the ways that are open.

people.name: The Moss-Abbess
greet: Careful, climber. The wood walks. Two wisps are bound in it, and the Hollow Elder waits at its heart, far to the north. Free the wisps, cut the roots that feed it, and its door opens.

people.name: The Path-Lighter
greet: I lose things in this wood, and the wood keeps them. Maybe you can bring them back.

people.name: The Kiln-Mother
greet: You found the burners’ clearing? Then you can stand by it a while.

people.name: The Amber-Seller
greet: Shards for what you need. The wood takes nothing back, so I take shards.

quests.name: The Heart of the Wood
intro: Clear the hounds’ den, and its wisp follows you: lead it to the heart. Then the stag glade: the Stag-Crowned guards the second wisp. Last, cut the three roots that feed the Hollow Elder, and its door opens.
outro: The wisps are home, the roots are cut. The Hollow Elder’s door stands open, far in the north. Rest first, then go in.

steps.text: Lead the wisp from the hounds’ den to the heart
steps.name: The wisp

steps.text: Lead the wisp from the stag glade to the heart
steps.name: The wisp

steps.text: Cut the three roots that feed the heart
Go to the Hollow Elder’s door

quests.name: The Hollow Hunter
intro: The Hollow Hunter walks round the old oak. Fell it and the wood grows calmer.
outro: A relic from the old wood. Keep it.

quests.name: Briarback
intro: Briarback walks the far glades. Nobody lights the lamps while it does.

quests.name: The Spore Lamps
intro: Two spore lamps: one at the mossy spring, one at the wayside shrine. Light both, stand by each a moment, and I can see the paths move.
outro: Now I can see. Take this, it was in the moss.

quests.name: The Lost Bundle
intro: Hazel dropped a bundle in the dark thicket and will not go back for it. Carry it to the camp fire. A hit and you drop it.

steps.text: Bring the bundle from the dark thicket to the fire

quests.name: The Burners’ Watch
intro: My stacks lie past the burners’ clearing. Find them, then hold the clearing while I bring the charcoal in: the hounds smell the smoke.
outro: All in, and dry. Take this.

steps.text: Hold the clearing while the charcoal comes in

doors.name: The Hollow Elder’s door
doors.locked: Roots hold the door shut. The Moss-Abbess has a quest about the wisps.

doors.name: The gate up
doors.locked: The gate is sealed. Its warden answers only once the Hollow Elder has fallen.

lines: Another climber. I am Sefu. Walk into the thicket behind me and we see who is better. Win, and I fight beside you.

lore.name: The root stone
text: Moss grows on the north side, they say.
Here it grows on the side you are not looking at.

hound.name: Bark hound
hound.blurb: Fast, and hunts in a pack.

named1.name: The Hollow Hunter
named1.blurb: Walks round the old oak and strikes hard.

named2.name: Briarback
named2.blurb: Walks the far glades and strikes hard.

root.name: Feeding root
root.blurb: A root that feeds the heart. It cannot move; it throws thorns.

ruler.name: The Hollow Elder
ruler.title: Older than the paths
ruler.line: Cut the roots that feed it; it stands open when none is left
